question: Do you really make your ice cream yourselves?
answer: Everything you see in our display case is made by us in our own ice cream kitchen. We don't mix ready-made powders, but rather compose each recipe individually with a lot of time, care, and the best raw ingredients. This artisanal approach is more laborious, but it pays off with the unique texture and full, authentic taste. With us, you still get honest craftsmanship instead of industrial standard goods off the shelf.

question: Do you also have vegan ice cream?
answer: Diversity is very important to us, which is why a fixed part of our ice cream counter is always reserved for our vegan connoisseurs. Our sorbets consist of pure fruit pulp and water, while our dairy-free cream varieties are often based on oat or almond. We want every guest to be happy with us, no matter what diet they personally prefer. Feel free to stop by and let yourself be surprised by our latest plant-based innovations.

question: What ingredients go into your ice cream?
answer: Quality begins with us already with the careful purchase of raw materials, which is why we prefer to work with regional partners. Only the best ingredients such as noble cocoa, fine vanilla, and fresh cream find their way into our ice cream machines. We consistently do without chemicals and artificial flavor enhancers to fully preserve the natural purity of the aromas. Your enjoyment and the quality of our products are close to our hearts.

question: Can Nicezeit be booked for events?
answer: Are you looking for a real crowd-puller for your next event or garden party? We would be happy to come with our mobile station and transform your event into an unforgettable, sweet taste experience. Our team ensures a good mood and serves handmade ice cream directly from the crispy cone or cup. Simply contact us by email to discuss the details for your individual catering package.

question: Why are you closed in winter?
answer: While it's snowing outside, we give our ice cream machines a little break and dedicate ourselves to planning for the next year. Since we place extreme value on absolute freshness, production in the cold season makes little sense for our concept. We prefer to use the time for further training and exciting experiments so that we can inspire you with new taste explosions in spring. We'll see you again soon, as soon as nature awakens from its winter sleep!
